Definition: plural of a derivative of G2264; Herodians, i.e. partisans of Herod:--Herodians.
BiblicalUsage: Hērōdianoí means the Herodians, the partisans of Herod. They stand 3 times in the Gospels, in Mark and Matthew, always plotting with the Pharisees against Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the Herodians as they stand — a party that chose power over truth — and I read the passages with that plain sense in mind.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals a Man with a Withered Hand; Render to Caesar
